dedupe_keys.name: azerbaijan residential buildings stock and housing commissioning annual 1995 2024 state statistics committee

description: State Statistics Committee of the Republic of Azerbaijan (Azərbaycan Respublikasının Dövlət Statistika Komitəsi) publishes two annual national time series: the number of residential buildings (houses) in thousands, split into state-owned and non-state-owned (1,705.3 thousand in 2024 against 980.5 thousand in 1995), with urban and rural variants on the portal, and the commissioning of housing (total floor area in thousand square metres, number of houses, floor area built by households, floor area per 1,000 inhabitants and the number of flats). Coverage: Azerbaijan nationally, 30 annual rows from 1995 to 2024; the portal records were modified on 2025-12-22. Format and access: CSV files, free and without registration from the Azerbaijan open data portal; the portal catalogue is queryable through a public CKAN API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Creative Commons CCZero (CC0, as shown by the portal); cost: free. Caveats: the series are national aggregates with no location, structure type or building age, the column headers are in Azerbaijani, and the portal pages carry no description text. Simulation uses: national housing-stock growth and construction-rate inputs for long-run building-stock and energy-demand scenarios. Related catalogue records: OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
